notes: Peer-reviewed Antiquity Project Gallery. Cambridge Core full text (accessed 2026-10-11): site in western Guanghan County, ~40 km NE of Chengdu; area ~12 km²; dates c. 2700–1000 BC; discovered 1928; first excavation 1934 (David C. Graham); 1986 Pits 1–2 with >900 bronze, gold, jade, ivory artefacts (citing Sichuan 1999); six new pits (3–8) adjacent; Pit 4 six radiocarbon dates 1260–924 cal BC (citing Wu et al. 2021); authors’ working scheme: Pits 1–4, 7, 8 roughly Yinxu Phase IV (~1200–1000 BC), Pits 5–6 probably early Western Zhou (~1046–950 BC) — chronology long debated; put disputed absolute endpoints in Notes.
